## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] `dotnet test GeesNO.Core.sln --no-build` passes, or the reason it was not run is explained.
- [ ] `dotnet format GeesNO.Core.sln --verify-no-changes --no-restore` passes, or the reason it was not run is explained.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when public API, behavior, packages, security, support, or compatibility changed.
- [ ] Breaking changes are explicit and include migration notes when relevant.
- [ ] Commits include DCO `Signed-off-by` lines.
- [ ] The change preserves the Foundation boundary: headless, vendor-neutral, AI-neutral, software-neutral, and domain-neutral.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private payloads, unnecessary local paths, or stack traces are included.
- [ ] Suspected vulnerabilities are not disclosed in this pull request.
